Deferred Voxel Shading for Real Time Global Illumination
Deferred voxel shading is a four-step real-time global illumination technique inspired by voxel cone tracing and deferred rendering. This approach enables us to obtain an accurate approximation of a plethora of indirect illumination effects including: indirect diffuse, specular reflectance, color-blending, emissive materials, indirect shadows ...
